newsitem.title: UK: BFI maintains rise, up six points.
newsitem.headline: BFI maintains rise, up six points.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index rose six points on Monday to 1,029.
Brokers said that although October rates in the Atlantic were basically unchanged, there were reports of substantial fresh enquiry for most classes of tonnage except Capers for first half November.
All Panamax rates were marked higher in today's index but Capers remained mostly unchanged.
ADM fixed Grafton for 87,000 grains 55 ft US Gulf to Rotterdam for Nov 6/15 at a lumpsum equivalent of $9.75 and brokers expected November grain rates in general to improve.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was unchanged to five points down and turnover was only 16 lots.
